name: danburn
description: Danburn — a Claude Code plugin that drafts Quality Management Plans for Korean construction sites. 단번(Danburn) 품질관리계획서 도구 플러그인

plugins.name: danburn
plugins.description: Draft a Quality Management Plan from a bill of quantities (/danburn:start), export the test plan alone (/danburn:test-plan), check an existing plan against current standards (/danburn:check). 도급내역서로 품질관리계획서 만들기(/danburn:start), 품질시험계획서만 한글·엑셀로 따로 내기(/danburn:test-plan), 기존 계획서 기준 검사(/danburn:check).
